name: t5probe_pc
description: Phase 3 T5 PROBE -- CONTROL (known negative). Throwaway 1 km probe run, not a shippable scenario: it exists to answer the multicell initiation question against the classifier pre-registered in docs/phase3-t5-multicell.md §3, which was committed before this config was written. Expected: SINGLE CELL. single_cell_333m's storm keys at probe resolution -- zero shear, static domain (a pulse cell does not translate). timax is 7200 like every other probe rather than its shipped 3600, because the pre-registration promises IDENTICAL settings; the cell simply dies inside the window and its late frames read as zero echo. Probe geometry is T4 §5.2's: 180x180 @ 999 m = 179.82 km, 2 h, dtl=6, ~13 min per run instead of ~4.5 h at 333 m. The 1 km caveat is stated in docs §6.1 -- component counts may bias low; the REGIME call is what survives at this resolution.
